# Live LinkedIn Profile Scraper

> Scrape a live full LinkedIn profile from a profile URL. A miss is free. Starting from $0.90 per 1,000 live profiles.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. A hit returns the profile fetched at run time: headline, company, experience with dates and descriptions, education, skills, certifications, courses, languages, publications, and patents. A miss is not charged. The response does not include email or phone.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-live-linkedin-profile
- Call: `oday/mawsool-live-linkedin-profile`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Price

Gold, Platinum, and Diamond are $0.90 per 1,000 live profiles. Silver is $1.60. Bronze is $2.00. The free plan is $2.50. A miss is free.

## Use it when

You have LinkedIn profile URLs and you want the full live profile, including a large file.

## Use something else when

The URL does not open: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-fix-broken-linkedin-urls
You only need company and headline: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-freshness
You need the personal email: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-personal-email-finder
